note: Wikimedia Commons, “Martyrion Agion Theodorou Konstantinou Kallistratou Theophilou Synaou Dionysiou.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Tzortzis Phouka — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons' own description reads «Fresco of the martyrdom of Saints Theodore, Constantine, Kallistratos, and Theophilos of the 42 Amorian Martyrs from Dionysiou Monastery», and the file is the sole member of Category:42 Martyrs of Amorion. The company itself is this folder's saint - doxologia.ro's line for 6 March reads «Sfintii 42 de Mucenici din Amoreea» - so a fresco naming four of the forty-two in their joint martyrdom is the folder's own subject, not a near-namesake. A 1547 fresco by Tzortzis Phouka at Dionysiou on Athos. The 1903-1911 Russian plate set has no plate for the company: its 07061 for 6 March is Konon. Commons describes it: Fresco of the martyrdom of Saints Theodore, Constantine, Kallistratos, and Theophilos of the 42 Amorian Martyrs from Dionysiou Monastery
